resources.string: \? How do I get transfer codes?
\? How do I use transfer codes?
Tap “Receive save with transfer codes” to start editing The Battle Cats!

string-array.name: transfer_help_get_steps
string-array.item: Open Options on the game title screen, then choose Account / Data Transfer.
Choose the device change / data transfer procedure.
Choose to transfer game data out of this device.
Read the game notice and upload the save to generate transfer codes. Keep the game online until it finishes.
Keep both the transfer code and confirmation code private. Return to BCSFE, enter both codes, select the matching game region, then receive the save.

string-array.name: transfer_help_use_steps
string-array.item: Keep the new codes shown by BCSFE. Open Options on the game title screen, then choose Account / Data Transfer.
Choose the device change / data transfer procedure.
Choose to receive existing game data on this device.
Enter the new transfer code and confirmation code from BCSFE, then start the transfer. Use the matching game region and wait for the game to finish.
